title: v1AwsCloudAccount
description: AWS cloud account which includes access key and secret key in case of 'secret' credentials type. It includes policyARNS, ARN and externalId in case of sts. It includes roleArn and permissionBoundaryArn in case of podIdentity. Partition is a group of AWS Region and Service objects

partition.description: AWS accounts are scoped to a single partition. Allowed values [aws, aws-us-gov], Default values

podIdentity.description: AWS EKS Pod Identity credentials in case of credentialType podIdentity, will be empty in case of other credential types

policyARNs.description: List of policy ARNs required in case of credentialType sts.

secretToken.description: AWS account secret token; in case of aws-iso and aws-iso-b

sts.description: AWS STS credentials in case of credentialType sts, will be empty in case of credential type secret

v1AwsCloudAccountCredentialType.description: Allowed Values [secret, sts, pod-identity]. STS type will be used for role assumption for sts type, accessKey/secretKey contains the source account, Arn is the target account. Pod Identity type will be used for EKS Pod Identity authentication with roleArn as the target account.

v1AwsPodIdentityCredentials.description: AWS EKS Pod Identity credentials for role assumption

permissionBoundaryArn.description: Optional Permission Boundary ARN to limit the maximum permissions for roles created by Hubble

roleArn.description: IAM Role ARN for the AWS EKS Pod Identity in cloud account

v1AwsSecretSpec.description: AWS cloud account which includes access key and secret key in case of 'secret' credentials type. It includes policyARNS, ARN and externalId in case of sts. Partition is a group of AWS Region and Service objects

accountName.description: AWS secret accountName; only for aws-iso-b environment

isCapValidationEnabled.description: Flag to rotate the secret region credentials

mission.description: AWS secret mission; only for aws-iso environment

tls.description: TLS configuration for the AWS secret

v1AwsSecretTlsConfig.description: TLS configuration for the AWS secret

arn.description: Arn for the aws sts credentials in cloud account

externalId.description: ExternalId for the aws sts credentials in cloud account
